extracted.intended_audience: systematic reviewers and clinical researchers in orthopedics/medicine
extracted.subtask_description: A PRISMA 2020-registered systematic review and meta-analysis protocol to quantify and compare postoperative inflammatory marker trajectories after total knee arthroplasty (TKA) between Indian and international populations, including unilateral and bilateral procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA 2020 compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: A PRISMA 2020 compliant methodology will be followed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PRISMA 2020 reporting standards (e.g., use PRISMA checklist and flow diagram, transparent methods for search, selection, data extraction, risk of bias assessment, and synthesis). Ensure all required PRISMA items are addressed in the protocol and final report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary objective: quantify and compare inflammatory marker trajectories
rubrics_metrics.description: Quantify and compare postoperative inflammatory marker trajectories following total knee arthroplasty (TKA) in Indian versus international populations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify comparisons between population groups (Indian vs international), define population inclusion criteria (geographic/country definitions), and prespecify subgroup or sensitivity analyses to examine between-population differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes: CRP, IL-6, ESR, TNF-α
rubrics_metrics.description: Synthesize quantitative data on C-reactive protein (CRP), interleukin-6 (IL-6), erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extract and pool numeric measures for these specific biomarkers; report units, assay methods and timepoints. Prespecify how to handle differing measurement units or assays and plan for harmonization or conversion where needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcome metrics: peak values, timing of peaks, normalization kinetics
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus on peak values, timing of peaks, and normalization kinetics after unilateral and bilateral procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define operational criteria for 'peak value', 'timing of peak' (e.g., postoperative day), and 'normalization' (e.g., return to baseline or specified threshold). Prespecify acceptable time windows and how to handle studies reporting limited timepoints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure-type stratification: unilateral versus bilateral TKA
rubrics_metrics.description: Compare marker trajectories after unilateral and bilateral procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform subgroup analyses or stratified syntheses by procedure type. Define inclusion rules for studies that mix or do not clearly separate unilateral and bilateral cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meta-analysis model: random-effects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use random-effects pooling to account for between-study heterogeneity; prespecify choice of estimator (e.g., DerSimonian-Laird, REML), heterogeneity metrics (I2, tau2), and planned sensitivity analyses if heterogeneity is high.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical-interpretation objective: implications for management and surveillance
rubrics_metrics.description: Examine the clinical implications of population-specific inflammatory kinetics for postoperative pain management, infection surveillance, and rehabilitation progression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translate quantitative differences into practical recommendations or considerations for clinicians (e.g., altered timing of infection surveillance, pain-control protocols, rehabilitation milestones). Prespecify criteria for clinical significance versus statistical significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population definition: Indian versus international populations
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicitly compare Indian populations to international populations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define how 'Indian' and 'international' are categorized (by country, care setting, ethnicity) and prespecify inclusion/exclusion for studies based on setting or patient origin; consider conducting sensitivity analyses based on region or income level.
